Common Questions

How do I measure my under-sink cabinet before buying organizers?

Measure three things: total interior depth, distance from the side wall to the plumbing pipe, and height from the cabinet floor to the bottom of the sink basin. Always leave 1 inch of clearance for cabinet door hinges.

What is the best renter-friendly way to organize under a kitchen sink?

Stick to freestanding L-shaped pull-out drawers, silicone drip mats, tension rods, and over-the-door caddies. None of them require drilling into cabinet wood.
